test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The budding photographer used to __climbed up__ the hill every morning to capture the beauty of the rising sun.
solution:
The correct answer is : '**climb up**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Whenever in the sentence word **used to **is used we don't use **II nd** form of verb.
 
• Always use I st form of verb with **used to**.
 
• Using **climbed up **is wrong instead of that use **climb up.**

 
• **​climbed up **is II nd form if verb
 
• **climb up** is I st form of verb.

 
• 'climbed' is the II nd</strong
